You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Auburn Park kiosk","question":"Can maintenance record the replacement screen as tested?","claims":{"A":"The replacement kiosk screen passed the midday brightness test.","B":"Maintenance issued ticket P3 on Friday.","C":"Ticket P3 concerns the south gate kiosk."},"sources":{"S1":"ticket P3 identifies the east gate kiosk.","S2":"maintenance log records ticket P3 issued Friday.","S3":"the parts invoice lists a nominal brightness rating. Ticket status was automatically set to complete after invoice ingestion."},"follow_up":{"S4":"independent photometer check confirms the replacement screen missed the midday brightness requirement."}}

message.content: {"claims":{"A":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S4"],"confidence":90},"B":{"status":"supported","citations":["S2"],"confidence":95},"C":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S1"],"confidence":90}},"note":"Claim A is contradicted by the independent photometer check in S4 showing the replacement screen failed the midday brightness test, despite the nominal brightness rating in S3. Claim B is supported by the maintenance log in S2 confirming ticket P3 was issued on Friday. Claim C is contradicted by S1, which identifies ticket P3 as concerning the east gate kiosk, not the south gate."}

parsed.note: Claim A is contradicted by the independent photometer check in S4 showing the replacement screen failed the midday brightness test, despite the nominal brightness rating in S3. Claim B is supported by the maintenance log in S2 confirming ticket P3 was issued on Friday. Claim C is contradicted by S1, which identifies ticket P3 as concerning the east gate kiosk, not the south gate.
